Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the major 
maintenance procedure P1, which must be carried out when 
the gas turbine have major maintenance after 40,0000 workhour.
The technical Data:
- Stober double damper 
type ( E ) electrical actuator drive,
- There are 4 actuators ( 2 isolate & 2 control ),
- Every damper has 4 shafts the shaft have to flanged bearing and 2 
center bearing.
The first draft initiated by eng. El Kehlawy 
Mostafa Mousa, tested by eng. Abdel Qader Fath Allah at 28 
April 2003 on Boiler no. 4 and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abdel 
Gilel, accepted by general director eng. Sobhy Mohamed El Bakry 
and approved by eng. Moneer Mohamed El Wakeel Head Sector 
of Demiatta PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes
HRSG is out of service
Disconect the power supply of damper actuators and tagged it
G .T. out of service ( excitation C.B & unit aux .C.B &low voltage trans .C.B 
)is rack out
Make scaffolding inlet and outlet the boiler dampers
All safety precaution must be followed by safety dep.
Tools and Equipment
Air 
 hammer & riveting tool
Kit of key and aln
Seal cord ,center bearing & flanged bearing & rivet & bolts & packing
Welding filler & welding machine
Work to be Carried Out
Check shaft wear at center bearing {welding and grinding }if need
Check flanged bearing {replacement the defect and greasing }
Check center bearing replacement the defect
Replace the bad packing for stuffing box and tight it
Change the bad seal cord for blades
Weld the cracks of the frame and adjust the deflection in shaft
Change the mechanical drive defects for actuators
Change the gear box if defect
Check all (bolts&nuts) for damper blades and change the 
 defect.
Check linkage rod and repair or change the defect.
Adjust the damper blades at( close 
 and open ) states mechanically 
 arranging with instrument dep.
